$comment: IconButton call sites whose glyph is itself a ring (Info / CircleHelp / HelpCircle) and that still rely on the default variant instead of saying `variant="plain"` out loud. One entry per file. The behaviour is already correct — the default is `plain` — this list exists because the guard requires the answer to be visible in the source, so the next reader cannot 'tidy' it into `solid`. Delete an entry in the same commit that writes the variant out: a stale entry fails the guard.
